body.message: Hello! We are looking for a furnished apartment with 2 separate bedrooms for 2 adults, approximately 24 September–15 December 2026. Regarding the Elite Business Bay listing: please quote the actual rent for September, October, November and 1–15 December, and the total for the full stay. We need monthly payments and no annual contract. Can you offer a fixed rent of up to AED 12,500 per month throughout the stay, without seasonal increases above that amount? Please itemise VAT, tourism fees, utilities, cleaning, agency fee and refundable deposit separately, and confirm the partial-month calculation and availability. If this unit is unavailable, please send suitable 2-bedroom alternatives. This is an enquiry only, not a booking. Thank you!
